item.title: 1981 Pontiac Firebird Turbo Trans Am Daytona Pace Car Edition
item.description: This 1981 Pontiac Firebird Turbo Trans Am is one of 2,000 Daytona Pace Car Edition units produced for the model year, and this example spent time in Ohio prior to its 2020 acquisition by the selling dealer. Finished in white with Daytona 500 Pace Car graphics over red and black cloth upholstery, the car is powered by a turbocharged 4.9-liter V8 mated to a three-speed automatic transmission. item.title: 1994 Jeep Wrangler SE 4.0 5-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 1994 Jeep Wrangler SE remained registered in California from new until the current owner's acquisition in 2019, and it now shows 52k miles. item.description: This 1969 Bultaco Metralla underwent a refurbishment prior to being purchased by the selling dealer in 2025 with work that included refinishing the bodywork in black and silver with gold pinstriping. item.title: 32k-Mile 1969 Jaguar XKE Series II Roadster at No Reserve
item.description: This 1969 Jaguar XKE Series II roadster was sold new by Gruet Motor Car Company in St. Louis, Missouri, and would spend more than three decades under the care of its first owner, who added approximately 29k of the 32k miles shown. The car then remained with two subsequent owners until it was acquired by the selling dealer in October 2025.
